items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: No way. Norman Granz, he may have tried to pull somebody, but he didn't have that influence to do that.

ctx.x: So Norman Granz wasn't connected with it?

No way. Norman Granz, he may have tried to pull somebody, but he didn't have that influence to do that. Because the guys may have played, recorded with him or something like that. But travel with him? No way. No way.
Now, those guys were out of the band for about three years, though.
